body.message: Hello, i am a resident in Elite business tower and its been 2 times in a week that my Access card is not working and i cannot Access Gym, swimming pool and parking. Today the security guard told me we can’t open the parking barrier because Fam Living has not provided the documents and your ijari is expired. He said we won’t let your car out and if go once we cannot open it for you to come in. I’m waiting now for the parking. Please look into this matter ASAP!
